notes.title: "Black Screen" Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Wolf & Wood has just rolled out a bug fix  for a "black screen" issue that was affecting a small number of users for the episodic version of The Exorcist.  It was related to how some saved games were versioned. Thank you to those affected players who sent in their player logs to help us locate and exorcise this nasty little demon!   -   Nota res mala, optima.

If you have not yet experienced episode 1 but would like to dive in with all five episodes in their entirety,  the Deluxe Edition is available for all major headsets including Valve Index.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156250/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Deluxe_Edition/

notes.title: Bug Fixes & WMR Support Added!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/aa19414b9e9580b7cab5aa692380824dc7d86d86.gif

Hello Exorcists! We just rolled out an update for all episodes yesterday.  Please make sure you download this patch before heading out on your next demonic encounter.

Fixes & Improvements:

 An issue whereby some controllers would stop working after picking up the Holy Water in Episode 1 "First Rites" has been fixed.
 For those who prefer snap turn over free turning, swipe rotation on the Vive wands has been fixed.
 We now fully support WMR headsets and controller support has been added!



in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti...

notes.title: Index controllers, bug fixes, teleport improvements, etc.
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/c9a217e7844eebec7f6b3c1ed6943e34406ef575.gif

Valiant Exorcists! Today we have rolled out some updates to the episodic version of The Exorcist: Legion VR.  Your feedback has been incredibly valuable.

 Index Controller support - Can connect index controllers at run-time without any issue.
 Fixed a "black screen" issue that was affecting a small number of users at start of game.
 Fixed bugs involving people getting permanently stuck in out of bounds.
 Added fail-safes for the crucifix occasionally disconnecting from the kit and becoming unusable.
 Fixed bug where hands would sometimes get stuck in the hover state and the player would not be able to make a fist.
 Improved crouching and fixed an issue where the play area marker wouldn't stay on the floor whilst smoothly crouching
 Improved teleport movement so players no longer have to look directly down at the floor to teleport.
 Fixed a retrieval issue that occasionally occurred with the secret artifact in Chapter 1 (Source of the Nile).


For those of you who have not yet purchased any episodes, we want to let you know that we have released a Deluxe Version of the game which encompasses all FIVE chapters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156250/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Deluxe_Edition/

Happy Halloween! In nomine Patris et filii et Spiritus Sancti.

notes.title: Chapter 5 Achievements Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/aa19414b9e9580b7cab5aa692380824dc7d86d86.gif

Thanks to player feedback we were able to identify an issue which made obtaining "The Tomb" achievement, (completing Chapter 5 with 100%) impossible unless done on the first attempt.  That's too hard, even for us!

We've pushed out an update and Exorcists should now be able to make their way through Chapter 5 and obtain "The Tomb" achievement at any time, including 2nd and 3rd attempts. Who knows, you might just see something you missed before.

There are a total of five achievements in Chapter 5 including "Lost Little Lamb", "Afraid of the Dark", "No Respect", "Chapter 5" and "The Tomb".

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/19366549118a9f515301e09de33e63c28899d4d8.jpg
   
Many players have reached out to us regarding the "Puke" achievement.  We won't tell where the achievement is, but it is definitely obtainable, and only requires access to the police station.

notes.title: Chapter 3 Gameplay Trailer and Release Date!
notes.notes:
We've posted the new game play trailer for Chapter 3, Skin Deep up on the chapter page, and set the release date for January 25th!...  just one week from today!   We have been asked the meaning behind the title, but we'll leave that for you to discover.

A new artifact, new achievements, and a new demon.  Her looks can be very deceiving.  Other small audio and cosmetic enhancements have been added to your office as well as the precinct. 

This chapter was very challenging from a story & technical perspective, and we're so anxious to share it with you.  

- The Exorcist: Legion VR team
